name: GREENOX
note: Sleeve partner (Ärmelpartner) and premium partner of VfB Stuttgart from 28 August 2026, taking over the sleeve from hep solar (Footy Headlines). Rating note: the two shareholders named by the club are individuals; no state or state-fund owner found. The full list is not public: North Data counts five active shareholders but their names are paywalled.
verdict: Stuttgart energy-consulting and building-renovation company (GREENOX GmbH, founded 2023), whose named shareholders are Maximilian Seifert and Christoph Brechtel. Nothing found.
